content.name: Heavy Centaur Prototype VRO
content.description: Compatibility patch that fits the Heavy Centaur Prototype to Variety and Rebalance Overhaul (VRO): hull, drag, internal shields, VLS torpedo launcher, missiles and the HCP turrets (VRO damage, hull and price of the medium turret of the same weapon), plus HCP versions of the VRO Mass Driver and Flechette turrets.
content.author: Darkona
